item.title: Charter plane crash kills 8 near remote radar site in western Alaska, military says
item.description: A charter aircraft carrying eight people crashed at a remote radar site in western Alaska on Thursday, killing all on board, the U.S. military said.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: 'Survival mode': Indiana residents endure a ninth day without power
item.description: Tens of thousands of people in Indiana are entering a second week without power after a deadly storm toppled trees and power lines. Schools remain closed and businesses have been unable to reopen.

item.title: 3 things to know about the $40 trillion federal debt
item.description: The U.S. federal debt hit a record $40 trillion this week. The debt has doubled since 2017, and just paying interest on the accumulated debt now costs the government more than $1 trillion a year.

item.title: D.C.'s IndyCar race will zoom past museums. Some worry it could harm the art inside

item.title: U.S. debt tops $40 trillion. And, new census report Trump is touting raises concerns
